name: MyFolio Authentication & Bot Access Guidelines
description: Guidelines and endpoints for automated AI agents and developers interacting with MyFolio.

authentication_methods.description: Public evaluation, studio visual previews, badge generation, templates catalog, and knowledge retrieval require zero authentication, API keys, or credit card.
Authenticated operations (saving builds, vanity subdomains, downloading standalone ZIP export packages) use secure JWT sessions issued upon login.

rate_limits.public_endpoints: 60 requests per minute burst / 2 requests per second sustained
